title: Glucose Variability in Subclinical Hypertrophy
brief_summary: Evaluation of insulin absorption at sites affected by clinically apparent lipohypertrophy through short-term continuous glucose monitoring has shown inconsistent results and it is yet unknown how or if subclinical lipohypertrophy affects absorption. In this study investigators propose to enroll at least 20 people who participated in phase 1 and who were determined to have subclinical lipohypertrophy to examine the correlation between glycemic control and amount of insulin injected in subclinical hypertrophic areas using capillary blood glucose and continuous glucose monitoring.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participation in phase 1
* Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes for at least 2 years
* Using insulin to manage diabetes
* At least 19 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Taking insulin secretagogues (gliclazide, glyburide, glipizide
* Taking other injectable diabetes medications (i.e. liraglutide, Victoza)
* Taking systemic steroids (e.g. prednisone)
* Not fluent in speaking and writing English (unless accompanied by a translator)
